meta.name: image-editing
meta.description: Edit existing images with Bria, Reve and Phota via inference.sh CLI. Apps: Bria Eraser, Bria Gen Fill, Bria Expand, Bria Replace Background, Bria Increase Resolution, Bria Product Cutout, Bria Product Packshot, Bria Product Shadow, Bria Image Edit, Reve Edit, Reve Remix, Phota Edit, Phota Enhance. Capabilities: object removal, mask-based generative fill, outpainting, background replacement, instruction-based editing, multi-image remix, identity-preserving edits, photo enhancement, 2x/4x upscaling, product cutouts, packshots and shadows. Use for: photo retouching, e-commerce product images, removing objects, changing backgrounds, extending images. Triggers: edit image, image editing, photo editing, remove object, erase object, inpainting, generative fill, outpainting, expand image, extend canvas, uncrop, replace background, change background, edit with text, instruction edit, bria, reve edit, reve remix, phota, enhance photo, increase resolution, product cutout, packshot, retouch

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
